run_MCMC_inference: run SingleSiteAncestralMetropolisHastings inference with queries, observations, and multiple chains on a probabilistic model
run_NUTS_inference: run GlobalNoUTurnSampler inference with full or reduced mass matrix on a probabilistic model
define_random_variable: define a random variable using the bm.random_variable decorator returning a torch distribution
define_functional_variable: define a deterministic functional variable using the bm.functional decorator over random variables
initialize_world: initialize a World with queries and an optional init_from_prior function for sampling
